inputs.prompt: ONE original tall feminine living tree, the Orchardheart Matriarch veteran, facing screen right in slightly elevated three-quarter view. Keep the pale ivory carved wooden face with a pointed nose and dark eyes, the crown of branching twigs, the broad arched canopy of olive leaves and small white blossoms growing from the back and shoulders, the hanging pear-shaped golden-green seed lanterns and trailing pale moss under the canopy, the glowing amber heartwood gem in the chest, the gnarled grey-brown bark body with moss and white flowers, and the thick root legs spreading at the base. No clothing. EXACTLY FOUR wooden arms: the upper pair are free branch hands; the lower pair hold ONE curved living-branch bow across the waist with a bright green bowstring and one glowing seed pod at its centre. Preserve the four arms, the bow, the canopy, the heart gem and the tall proportions. Loose ONE seed arrow toward screen right. The lower arms raise the branch bow and turn it toward screen right while an upper hand draws the green bowstring back with the glowing seed pod nocked, holds, then releases so the string snaps forward and the drawing hand opens, then the bow lowers back across the waist in the original stance. One shot only; the arrow is not shown, with no trail, beam or flash. Locked orthographic camera, fixed scale and centred body. Keep the whole canopy, every hanging lantern, the bow and the root feet within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, falling petals or leaves, arrows in flight, beams, magic, motion trails, particles or extra arms; the lanterns and heart gem keep only their steady glow. Articulate the branch joints naturally; the canopy sways but never morphs.
